chunks: So now taste My punishment and My commination!
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'So taste My punishment' signify in Surah Al-Qamar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the transition from the warning phase to the actualization of retribution, emphasizing that the 'warning' (nudhur) was not merely a threat but a fulfilled reality for those who persisted in denial. It reflects the divine justice where the punishment corresponds directly to the specific signs rejected by the disbelievers, a theme central to the narrative of Surah Al-Qamar regarding the fate of previous nations.
